frequency_question: How often do structural procedural blocks and floor time limits prevent confirmation of contested executive nominees when a vote is scheduled within a single-day final window?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet and agency head nominations that reached the Senate floor or were queued for a final vote under tight calendar constraints. Excludes routine uncontested voice votes.
coverage_note: 6 named prominent contested nominations from recent polarized sessions; represents the class of high-friction executive confirmations.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-cabinet posts that bypass major floor fights.
skeleton: Decomposed into contested agency head nominations facing procedural floor bottlenecks in the final 24 hours of availability.
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules and polarization levels remain stable through the current congressional session.
